Page | U.S. Representative William Timmons Securing the border is a fundamental responsibility of the federal government. Under President Trump’s leadership, America is once again enforcing the law. In just a short time, the Trump Administration has restored order at the Southern Border by reinstating proven policies that work—ending catch-and-release, reestablishing strong deterrence, and empowering Border Patrol to do their jobs. Illegal crossings are dropping because this Administration is serious about border security, national sovereignty, and protecting American communities.</p> <p dir="ltr">This stands in stark contrast to the Biden Administration’s disastrous record. President Biden deliberately dismantled effective border policies, opened the door to record-breaking illegal crossings, and allowed cartels to flourish while fentanyl poured into our country. That weakness cost lives, enriched criminal networks, and overwhelmed law enforcement. President Trump is reversing the damage and proving once again that strong leadership and enforcement—not empty rhetoric—are what secure the border and keep Americans safe.</p> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>&nbsp;</div>" /> Skip to Content Border Security Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Securing the border is a fundamental responsibility of the federal government. Page | U.S. Representative William Timmons Washington is broken. I came to Congress to hold the federal government accountable to the people. Our national debt and deficit are skyrocketing, with little concern for the burden we are imposing on our children and grandchildren. Americans deserve a Congress that effectively represents them, solves big problems, and gets things done. Since taking office, I have successfully advocated for changes to make Congress work better for the American people.</p> <p dir="ltr">For several years, I chaired the Select Committee on the Modernization of Congress, which worked to make Congress more effective, efficient, and transparent. We passed over 200 recommendations to improve how Washington operates. Today, many of those recommendations have been implemented and are helping Congress operate more efficiently. We worked to increase transparency, save taxpayer dollars, reduce waste and inefficiency, and reform our broken budget process.<br /> </p> <div>&nbsp;</div>" /> Skip to Content Congress Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Washington is broken. Page | U.S. Representative William Timmons The Biden Administration spent $7 trillion we did not have, and families across the nation paid the price through higher costs driven by inflation. Thankfully, commonsense leadership has returned to the White House and to Congress, with a renewed focus on lowering inflation, reducing the cost of groceries, and saving taxpayers billions of dollars.</p> <p dir="ltr">Additionally, last summer, Republicans voted to deliver the largest tax cut in American history, increasing Americans’ take-home pay by up to $13,300. Page | U.S. Representative William Timmons It is an honor and privilege to represent Veterans and their families in the United States House of Representatives. The land of the free is only possible because of the brave, and it is one of Congress’ most important responsibilities to care for our Veterans who have served with honor, strength, and sacrifice.</p> <p dir="ltr">As a Captain in the South Carolina Air National Guard, I am always looking for opportunities to provide further support for Veterans and their families. Our Veterans have selflessly dedicated their lives to serving our country, and now it is our turn to serve them. I will continue to support legislation and policies that ensure our nation’s Veterans receive the best possible care in a timely manner. We have an obligation to fulfill the promises made to those who have served, both on and off the battlefield.</p> <p dir="ltr">If you or someone you know is a Veteran in search of resources, please reach out to my office to explore available options and assistance. Page | U.S. Representative William Timmons I am proud to serve on the House Committee on Oversight and Accountability, where we work to rein in Washington and hold the federal government answerable to the American people. The Committee serves as a critical check on unelected bureaucrats and executive overreach by rooting out waste, fraud, and abuse; challenging the ever-growing regulatory state; and demanding transparency from powerful institutions. Our work exposes government mismanagement and political bias—whether in federal agencies, the media, or Big Tech—and ensures taxpayer dollars are spent responsibly and lawfully.</p> <p dir="ltr">I also serve as Chairman of the Military and Foreign Affairs Oversight Subcommittee. In this role, I focus on strengthening America’s national security by ensuring our servicemembers have the resources, readiness, and leadership they need to remain the most lethal fighting force in the world.
